_source: Copied from 7269a75d: apps/bridge/src/mcp-server.ts and mcp-context.ts (serverInfo, instructions, the search_decision_context definition, as its bridge answers initialize and tools/list), and the fixed wording of apps/desktop/src/main/decision-context-service.ts packages/core/src/decision-applicability.ts and DECISION_SCOPE_REJECTIONS in packages/protocol/src/decision-scope.ts. Change with the bridge. R17 (IMP-175) adds, by hand, the candidate App's fixed words for a record's date and for two records on a page with no judgment between them. R18 adds consultTool: consult_decision_principles as 7af5e85c's bridge answers tools/list (read from the 4de24ec6 build, whose apps/bridge/src is the same). IMP-183 appends the todo tools sentence to instructions, and IMP-184 names lists made to collect todos in it, as the bridge now answers initialize.
instructions: Use search_decision_context when coding or reviewing against past decisions, or preparing a decision handoff; verify project scope, source excerpts and supersession before applying historical evidence. Use consult_decision_principles before presenting meaningful choices or a recommendation. It reads adopted principles, and returns the user's own preferences and ideas that bear on the question separately labelled, never as principles; no match does not mean no relevant historical decision exists. These tools never replace current analysis or user confirmation. Use record_decision_journal_entry only for an explicit user directive, user-reported decision, or user-authored idea. An explicit standing directive may be recorded without asking a second time; never infer a stable preference from behavior. Use record_decision_consultation_feedback only after the user explicitly evaluates that consultation; never infer a rating. Use record_todo_list only when the user asks to save an investigation's findings as a Paraself todo list or to make a list to collect todos in (such as 日常 or 学习), or a standing instruction of theirs says to (one item per concrete finding), then work through the items one at a time with update_todo_item: done or dropped only with a note of what was done and how it was verified, or why it was dropped, never to tidy the list.

tool.name: search_decision_context
tool.title: Search historical decision context
tool.description: Read local historical decisions, recorded choices and adopted principles for coding, review or handoff. Supply repositoryPath for the actual task's local Git directory (including a worktree/subdirectory); never assume the MCP process cwd is the task repository. Git identity is resolved locally without network access or exposing remote credentials. Optional project explicitly filters recorded project names; module/files are literal repository-relative paths, layer is explicit frontend/backend/infrastructure/shared. Missing scope is marked for review; explicit exclusions are omitted unless includeOutOfScope or recordId is supplied. Empty query browses with limit/offset. Keyword matches come first in their order; when the local embedding model is available, up to 3 records close in meaning that no keyword matched follow them, counted in total and offsets, with matchReason giving the similarity; guidance says when that supplement is unavailable. No generative model, network, writes, adoption or preference retrieval.

query.description: Up to 2000 characters; empty browses with limit/offset.

repositoryPath.description: The task's local Git directory as an absolute path, up to 4000 characters.

module.description: a literal repository-relative path up to 1000 characters, without a leading /, .. or glob syntax.

files.description: Up to 100, each a literal repository-relative path up to 1000 characters, without a leading /, .. or glob syntax.

consultTool.name: consult_decision_principles
consultTool.title: Consult adopted decision principles
consultTool.description: Before the user chooses, read up to three locally adopted principles related to the current decision, matched by their text and by a local embedding model (no generative model; nothing leaves this machine). The user's own preferences and ideas that bear on it come back separately labelled as signals, never as principles. It does not choose an answer, write a decision, apply a principle, or open the Paraself app; each call is counted anonymously and returns a new token for record_decision_consultation_feedback.

question.description: The unresolved decision question before the user has chosen.

options.description: Candidate choices being considered; omit when still open-ended.

context.description: Only the task context needed to judge applicability and cautions.

project.description: Project name; defaults to the repository the MCP server was started in, which may not be the one you are working in: pass it when working in another repository.

languages.description: The programming languages of the code this choice is about (e.g. ["go"], ["typescript"]). Preferences the user kept for other languages are then left out; omitted, only those kept for languages the repository the MCP server was started in has no manifest of (go.mod, package.json, …) are, when this is about that repository.
